meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在将 NanoClaw v1 升级到 v2
copy.tagline_en: Finish migrating NanoClaw from v1 to v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are upgrading NanoClaw from v1 to v2

howto.what: 它帮你完成 v1 迁移的收尾：检查迁移脚本是否已运行，确认管理员身份，迁移聊天记录和记忆，核对容器配置，并协助移植自定义代码。
howto.when: 当你说“migrate from v1”、“finish migration”或“v1 migration”时触发；需先运行过 bash migrate-v2.sh。

say.text: 帮我完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移
say.note: 技能会开始检查迁移状态并执行收尾步骤。

say.text: 迁移中有些步骤失败了，帮我处理
say.note: 技能会查看迁移报告并修复阻塞问题。

say.text: 迁移后帮我核对容器配置
say.note: 技能会验证容器挂载路径并处理遗留配置。

howto.what_en: It helps you finish the v1-to-v2 migration: it checks whether the migration script ran, confirms the owner, migrates chat history and memory, reviews container config, and helps port custom code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'migrate from v1', 'finish migration', or 'v1 migration'; requires running `bash migrate-v2.sh` first.

say_en.text: Help me finish migrating from v1 to v2.
say_en.note: It will check migration status and run the remaining steps.

say_en.text: Some steps failed during migration, please handle them.
say_en.note: It will inspect the handoff and fix blockers.

say_en.text: After migration, please review the container config.
say_en.note: It will verify mounts and handle leftover configs.
